value.rationale: Triangle sparsity is the structural statistic explicitly used in the primary deletion-code graph argument. At the first nontrivial deletion radius, the formula gives the exact global clustering count for every block length and sharpens a general \(O(2^n n^3\log n)\) control to \(2^{n-3}n^3+O(2^n n^2)\). This is a natural all-length graph invariant, not an arbitrary finite census, while the package does not overclaim a new code-size theorem.
